from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib
root=Path('docs/poc/evidence/WU-27');out=root/'attempts/whitespace-01';out.mkdir()
rows=[]
for p in sorted(root.rglob('*')):
 if not p.is_file() or str(p).startswith(str(root/'raw/whitespace-01')) or str(p).startswith(str(out)):continue
 b=p.read_bytes()
 if b'\0' in b:continue
 try:b.decode('utf-8')
 except UnicodeDecodeError:continue
 trailing=any(line.rstrip(b'\r\n').endswith((b' ',b'\t')) for line in b.splitlines(keepends=True))
 eof=b.endswith(b'\n\n') or b.endswith(b'\r\n\r\n')
 if trailing or eof:
  path=str(p);assert '/archives/' in path or path.endswith(('.stdout','.stderr','/stdout','/stderr','.log'))
  rows.append({'path':path,'bytes':len(b),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),'trailing':trailing,'blankEOF':eof})
report={'status':'proposed-owned-literal-exceptions-only','scope':'Review proposal only; no .gitattributes/index write. Exact immutable owned archives/logs; no active code/wildcard/reference edit.','files':rows,'attributesPatch':['# WU-27 exact immutable owned archive/log byte whitespace exceptions.']+[r['path']+' -whitespace' for r in rows]}
(out/'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps({'files':len(rows),'report':str(out/'report.json')}))
